forecast-period.text: A low pressure system in the Bight will drift southeast as the associated trough crosses eastern South Australia clears before clearing later Friday. A weak high pressure system briefly moves across southern SA later Friday before a trough and cold front then move into the west from Saturday evening and cross the rest of SA on Sunday. A high will then push in behind the front and will move across the Bight early next week.
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones.

Showers and thunderstorms about central and eastern districts, clearing to the east by mid to late afternoon. Thunderstorms may be severe about far eastern districts in the late morning or early afternoon. Maximum temperatures above average, tending near average in the west. North to northwesterly winds in the east ahead of a freshening west to southwesterly change. Winds tending southeasterly in the west from the evening.

Patchy morning fog possible about the Eyre and Yorke Peninsulas, and the Flinders and Mid North districts. Light morning showers possible about southern coasts and the southeast. Showers and possible thunderstorms redeveloping in the west from the evening and more broadly about the agricultural areas overnight. Maximum temperatures above to well above average statewide. Light winds in the east tending north to northwesterly later. Freshening northeast to northwesterly winds in the west ahead of a west to southwesterly change in the far west late.

Showers and isolated thunderstorms about the agricultural areas and adjacent parts to the north, contracting to the northeast later. Isolated showers redevelop about the southern agricultural area late. Maximum temperatures above average, tending to below average in the far west. Fresh north to northwesterly winds in the east ahead of a fresh and gusty west to southwesterly change extending across during the day.

text.p: Isolated showers about the southern agricultural area, clearing by the evening. Slight chance of a shower or storm in the far northeast corner. Maximum temperatures below average, tending to above average in the far northeast. West to southwesterly winds about coastal areas, fresh at times. Winds tending southwest to southeasterly winds elsewhere, freshening at times further north.

Cumulative rainfall totals to the end of Monday: Less than 2 mm about the north and west. 2 to 10 mm across most of the state, with localised falls between 10 to 20 mm possible about the agricultural areas and parts of the pastoral districts. Localised falls between 20 to 40 mm are possible with thunderstorms.
